dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: From here on, I'll handle the follow-up work for the Lil' Fungi Playground. In the meantime, you should go and have fun with our Fungi friends.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Alright, Stormstress, we're gonna clean up the main streets and the docks of Bayda Harbor this afternoon!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: It's the easiest and most stable job that the two of us have right now. We can earn enough to buy ten servings of Marvelous Jelly in a single day, so let's both do our best!
